what: Phase 1 (this build): the MNL core, the inflated MNL, the existing IIA battery
title: polychoice: design document
text: mnl(): multinomial / conditional logit maximum likelihood case-specific covariates (alternative-specific coefficients), alternative- specific covariates (generic coefficients), alternative-specific constants, varying choice sets, frequency weights, offsets, unit fixed effects (dummies), analytic / robust / cluster-robust / bootstrap covariances. imnl(): baseline-inflated multinomial logit Bagozzi Marchetti (2017, PSRM), generalised inflated category either layout, logit probit split equation; multistart MNL fit. One engine, one object class, one set methods: print, summary, coef, vcov, logLik, nobs, fitted, residuals, predict, confint, update, simulate, broom (tidy/glance/augment), texreg. Quantities interest: predict() observed, outcome-stage, regime probabilities; first_difference() (delta-method simulation intervals, stage switch iop); rrr() relative risk ratios. Model fit comparison: fit_stats() (McFadden, Cox-Snell, Nagelkerke, count adjusted count R-squared, AIC, BIC), classification(), lr_test(), vuong() (AIC/BIC corrections), compare_models(). hausman_mcfadden() (Hausman McFadden 1984), classic variance-difference form seemingly-unrelated-estimation joint covariance (Weesie 1999; Stata mlogtest, suest), dropping alternative including base (handled exact re-basing full model). small_hsiao() (Small Hsiao 1985) correct form: full model halves, sqrt(1/2) weighting, restricted model second half; optionally repeated several random splits. fp_tests(): Fok Paap (2025, J. Choice Modelling) composite-likelihood Hausman test (Q1; default covariance joint influence-function estimate, F&P’s variance difference option, section 5) GMM overidentification test (Q2; default Hansen’s two-step efficient GMM, iterated form F&P projected form MLE options), base pairs pairs. iia_tests(): battery one table. Panel tools: mundlak(). Data: pres2004 (Campbell Monson 2008 analysed Bagozzi Marchetti 2017, Replication II) pa2006 (Arceneaux Kolodny 2009, Replication ), published fits regression tests.

title: Getting started with polychoice
text: Many outcomes social sciences unordered choices among several alternatives: vote one several candidates none, travel mode, type political action, treaty design. workhorse model multinomial logit (Theil 1969; McFadden 1974), comes two notations polychoice treats one model: multinomial logit wide layout, one row per case, case-specific covariates whose coefficients differ alternative (y ~ x1 + x2); conditional logit long layout, one row per case alternative, alternative-specific covariates whose coefficients common alternatives (chosen ~ w | x, id alt). choice probability P(yi=j)=aijexp⁡(Vij)∑kaikexp⁡(Vik),Vij=oij+xi′βj+wij′γ, P(y_i = j) = \frac{a_{ij} \exp(V_{ij})}{\sum_k a_{ik} \exp(V_{ik})}, \qquad V_{ij} = o_{ij} + x_i'\beta_j + w_{ij}'\gamma, aija_{ij} indicating whether alternative jj available case ii, βb=0\beta_b = 0 base alternative, offset oijo_{ij}. model’s convenience comes independence irrelevant alternatives (IIA): odds two alternatives depend others. polychoice provides estimators relax IIA (nested logit, heteroskedastic extreme value, multinomial probit, random intercepts), baseline-inflated multinomial logit Bagozzi Marchetti (2017) base alternative mixes two kinds cases, full battery tests IIA specification, behind one interface. vignette covers interface; companion vignettes cover inflated model, tests, models beyond IIA.

what: polychoice: Multinomial Choice, Inflated Multinomial Logit, and Tests of IIA
title: polychoice: Multinomial Choice, Inflated Multinomial Logit, and Tests of IIA
text: Multinomial choice models, inflated multinomial logit, tests independence irrelevant alternatives (IIA), R. Status: version 0.1.0. DESIGN.md repository gives scope, parameterisation, fixed definitions every test, verification protocol.

title: polychoice: Multinomial Choice, Inflated Multinomial Logit, and Tests of IIA
text: mnl(): multinomial / conditional logit case-specific covariates (alternative-specific coefficients), alternative-specific covariates (generic coefficients), alternative-specific constants, varying choice sets, frequency weights, offsets, unit fixed effects, analytic, outer-product (BHHH), robust, cluster-robust, bootstrap standard errors. Wide (one row per case) long (one row per case-alternative pair) layouts. imnl(): baseline-inflated multinomial logit Bagozzi Marchetti (2017, PSRM), inflated alternative, logit probit split equation; several inflated alternatives, parametrized logit captivity model Swait Ben-Akiva (1987), generalizes dogit Gaudry Dagenais (1979); captivity_test(), score likelihood-ratio tests multinomial logit captive choosers. nlogit(): two-level nested logit (RU2 / RUM-consistent form, mlogit Stata), free shared inclusive-value parameters. hev(): heteroskedastic extreme value model (alternative-specific scales), quadrature checked integrate() scale ratios 1.6e5 boundary flag scale runs zero. mnprobit(): multinomial probit free covariance utility differences (exact bivariate normal three alternatives, GHK Halton draws beyond). remnl(): multinomial logit random alternative-specific intercepts per unit (adaptive Gauss-Hermite quadrature; two alternatives reproduces lme4::glmer). rologit(): rank-ordered (exploded) logit complete, partial, tied rankings (exact tie likelihood; reproduces mlogit’s rank-ordered logit), rank_test() stability preferences across ranking stages. separation() exact check linear programming (ties groups). maximum-likelihood likelihood-ratio tests compare suprema log-likelihoods separation. boot_lr_test() calibrates , rank-ordered fits included. firth = TRUE (Firth’s penalty) prior = coef_prior(...) (normal, Cauchy t priors, Gelman et al.’s default scaling) give finite estimates mnl() rologit(), tied rankings included. come profile penalized-likelihood intervals (confint()) penalized likelihood-ratio tests (term_test(), combine_test(), lr_test(), rank_test()). Fixed-effects panels: unit dummies never-chosen rule, bias_correct = "jackknife" (split-panel jackknife slopes time-homogeneity gate). Quantities interest: predict() (observed-alternative, outcome-stage, regime probabilities), first_difference() (delta-method simulation intervals), rrr(). Fit comparison: fit_stats(), classification(), lr_test(), vuong(), boot_lr_test() (parametric-bootstrap LR Vuong tests restrictions boundary, multinomial logit inflated multinomial logit), compare_models(); broom, texreg, modelsummary support. IIA / misspecification tests: hausman_mcfadden() (variance-difference joint/suest forms, base drop handled exact re-basing), small_hsiao() (correct sqrt(1/2)-weighted form, repeatable splits), fp_tests() (Fok Paap 2025: composite-likelihood Hausman GMM overidentification), battery iia_tests(). specification tests: nested_lm_test() (McFadden 1987 score test IIA nested logit), combine_test() (Cramer-Ridder pooling alternatives), term_test() (joint Wald / LR tests per term), hl_test() (Fagerland-Hosmer-Bofin goodness fit), boot_pvalue() (parametric bootstrap calibration tests whose null fitted model). Simulators: rmnl(), rnlogit(), rhev(), rmnp(), rrologit(). Panel tools: mundlak(). Data: pa2006 pres2004, two applications Bagozzi Marchetti (2017); seven datasets published replication archives, sanctions (Liou 2024), fluvax (Liu et al. 2024), bes1987 (Glasgow 2001), defection (Oppenheim et al. 2015, re-analysed Cook, Niehaus Zuhlke 2018), bes2010 (Arzheimer Evans 2012), cabinets (Baeck, Debus Imre 2026) afghan_leaders (Bhatia Monroe 2024). published fits first four regression tests.
code: library(polychoice) data(pres2004) f <- vote ~ educ + female + black + hispanic + pid7 + bush_values + battleground + south + gmb +   agegroup + evangelical + evangelical:gmb + catholic + catholic:gmb + other_religion +   secular + secular:gmb + ideology + mobilization m0 <- mnl(f, data = pres2004) m1 <- imnl(vote ~ educ + female + black + hispanic + pid7 + bush_values + battleground + south + gmb +              agegroup + evangelical + evangelical:gmb + catholic + catholic:gmb + other_religion +              secular + secular:gmb + ideology + mobilization | educ + agegroup + mobilization + secular,            data = pres2004) compare_models(MNL = m0, BIMNL = m1) vuong(m1, m0) boot_lr_test(m0, m1, B = 99, cores = 4)   # calibrated (the multinomial logit is the boundary case of the inflated model); slow:                                           # every replicate refits the inflated model's multistart iia_tests(m0, seed = 1)

text: Every function help page examples (help(package = "polychoice")), five vignettes cover package: vignette("polychoice"): getting started (data layouts, fitting, quantities interest, model comparison). vignette("iia"): testing IIA specification, definition test bootstrap calibration. vignette("inflation"): inflated multinomial logit, several maxima, captive alternatives, tests multinomial logit. vignette("beyond"): nested logit, HEV, multinomial probit, random intercepts, fixed-effects panels. vignette("applications"): seven published analyses reproduced bundled data. repository also holds DESIGN.md , verification/, Monte Carlo scripts, run records release build, ledger results documentation cites. code: ## 40 units of 15 cases; each unit's effect on alternative b is ## correlated with its mean of x1 set.seed(1) unit <- rep(1:40, each = 15); u <- rnorm(40) x1 <- rnorm(600) + u[unit]; x2 <- rnorm(600) V <- cbind(0, 0.5 - x1 + 0.8 * x2 + u[unit], -0.3 + 0.6 * x1 - 0.5 * x2) y <- apply(exp(V) / rowSums(exp(V)), 1, function(p) sample(c("a", "b", "c"), 1, prob = p)) d <- data.frame(y = factor(y), x1, x2, unit) m <- mundlak(y ~ x1 + x2, d, unit = "unit") m$formula #> y ~ x1 + x2 + x1_mean + x2_mean #> <environment: 0x5c1f4d15b8e8> fit <- mnl(m$formula, m$data, cluster = "unit") ## the unit mean of x1 picks up the unit effect in b's equation; without ## the means x1's slope absorbs it. This pooled fit estimates average ## effects: its x1 slope is close to the within-unit -1 of the simulation ## only because the unit mean takes up nearly all of the unit effect here ## (15 cases per unit). remnl() on m$formula estimates the within-unit ## coefficients. coef(fit)[grep("x1", names(coef(fit)))] #>       b:x1  b:x1_mean       c:x1  c:x1_mean  #> -1.0542526  0.7851798  0.5203237 -0.1141086  coef(mnl(y ~ x1 + x2, d, cluster = "unit"))[c("b:x1", "c:x1")] #>       b:x1       c:x1  #> -0.6107817  0.4668951

title: Vuong test for non-nested or overlapping choice models — vuong
code: set.seed(2) d <- rmnl(800, beta = cbind(b = c(0.5, -1, 0.8), c = c(-0.3, 0.6, -0.5)),           delta = c(0.5, 1.2), inflate = "a") vuong(imnl(y ~ x1 + x2 | z1, data = d, inflate = "a"), mnl(y ~ x1 + x2, data = d)) #> Vuong test:  m1 = imnl(y ~ x1 + x2 | z1, data = d, inflate = "a") [ Inflated multinomial logit (inflated alternative: a, logit split) ] #>              m2 = mnl(y ~ x1 + x2, data = d) [ Multinomial logit ] #> positive statistics favor m1 #>  #>  correction statistic p_m1_better p_m2_better p_two_sided #>         raw     5.492           0           1           0 #>         AIC     5.294           0           1           0 #>         BIC     4.830           0           1           0 #> Note: The inflated multinomial logit and the multinomial logit are nested at the boundary phi = 1, where the normal reference does not hold for testing the uninflated model; boot_lr_test() calibrates the statistic.

title: polychoice 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN release. Features: Estimators mnl() (multinomial / conditional logit), imnl() (baseline-inflated multinomial logit Bagozzi Marchetti 2017; several inflated alternatives parametrized logit captivity model Swait Ben-Akiva 1987), nlogit() (two-level nested logit), hev() (heteroskedastic extreme value), mnprobit() (multinomial probit), remnl() (random alternative-specific intercepts, adaptive Gauss-Hermite quadrature), rologit() (rank-ordered logit complete, partial, tied rankings, exact tie likelihood Allison Christakis 1994). Firth’s penalized likelihood mnl() rologit() (firth = TRUE): finite estimates separation, tied rankings information exact tie probability; profile penalized-likelihood intervals (confint()) penalized likelihood-ratio tests (term_test(), combine_test(), lr_test(), rank_test()). penalized likelihood can one local maximum, penalized fit also runs maximum-likelihood estimate keeps higher. Priors mnl() rologit() (prior = coef_prior(...)): normal, Cauchy t priors centred zero coefficients scaled columns (Gelman et al. 2008), fitted posterior mode, penalized machinery firth = TRUE; fits several priors show much separated estimate comes prior. separation(): exact check separation mnl() rologit() data (linear program comparisons choices rankings report, ties included, lpSolveAPI), maximum-likelihood fits use name diverging coefficients. separation maximum-likelihood forms term_test(), combine_test(), lr_test() boot_lr_test() compare suprema log-likelihoods, optimizer stopped. boot_lr_test() also calibrates comparison two nested rologit() fits, drawing rankings case’s observed rank groups. Wide long data layouts, varying choice sets, frequency weights, offsets, unit fixed effects never-chosen rule split-panel jackknife (bias_correct = "jackknife"), analytic / outer-product / robust / cluster / bootstrap standard errors. Quantities interest: predict() (probabilities, classes, utilities, outcome-stage regime probabilities, posterior regime probabilities), first_difference(), rrr(). Fit comparison: fit_stats(), classification(), lr_test(), vuong(), boot_lr_test(), compare_models(); broom, texreg, modelsummary support. IIA specification tests: hausman_mcfadden(), small_hsiao(), fp_tests(), iia_tests(), nested_lm_test(), combine_test(), term_test(), hl_test(), boot_pvalue() (parametric bootstrap tests whose null fitted model); rank_test() (stability preferences across ranking stages); captivity_test() (score test multinomial logit captive choosers, dogit Gaudry Dagenais 1979, type = "lr" likelihood ratio constant captive share, lr_test() also takes). Simulators rmnl(), rnlogit(), rhev(), rmnp(), rrologit(); mundlak(). Data sets pa2006 pres2004 (Bagozzi Marchetti 2017), sanctions, fluvax, bes1987, defection, bes2010, cabinets, afghan_leaders published replication archives, vignette Seven published analyses.
